ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the quadrilateral $ABCD$ is inscribed in $\odot O$. If the quadrilateral $AOCD$ is a rhombus, what is the degree measure of $\angle B$? .
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in circle O,\\
it follows that $\angle B+\angle D=180^\circ$,\\
Since quadrilateral OACD is a rhombus,\\
it follows that $\angle AOC=\angle D$,\\
By the inscribed angle theorem, we have $\angle B= \frac{1}{2}\angle AOC$,\\
Thus $\angle B+2\angle B=180^\circ$,\\
Solving, we find $\angle B=\boxed{60^\circ}$.

From the text, AOCD is a rhombus, so AO = OC = CD = DA. Because O is the circle center, OA = OC = OD are radii.
